thesis: The morning thesis is intact. Q3 revenue was 259.9M (+60.7% YoY) with raised guidance, the uptrend holds (last 65.02 above SMA20 61.06, SMA50 57.39 and SMA200 46.07, RS63 +0.29), and healthcare is a leading sector in the risk-off regime. Today's 1.7% pullback came on light volume (0.79x) and held well above the 61.5 swing low. The intraday low of 64.81 traded inside the zone, so an entry was available. Entry at 65.02 gives R/R of about 1.98 against the preclose card's stop of 61.2 and target of 72.6 (the target is 0.1 below the morning's 72.7 because the card was recomputed). Confidence is trimmed from 0.42 to 0.40: the stock opened at 66.55, was rejected at 67.19 below the 68.03 high and is trading near the day's low. No debate was run in this session, and the rating is unchanged from the morning.
invalidation: Daily close below 61.2, or a push above 68.03 that fails and closes back below 63.4 on above-average volume.
key_risks: Risk-off regime (QQQ ret_21 -8.1%, VIX pct 0.858) and beta 1.808: a market flush can reach a stop only about 1.2 ATR (3.82) below 65.02
